name: moe_wgs_l2hint_v1
hypothesis: Removing the explicit TMA L2 cache hint on WGS weight copies may improve cache residency and reduce memory pressure for the scored large-weight path.
result: All six output comparisons passed reference. Disabling the explicit TMA L2 cache hint regressed every batch/seed pair, by up to 5.5% at batch 256. Keep the current hint.
change: Compile the WGS main kernel with OKC_L2H=0; dataflow and layouts unchanged.
